task: Official evacuation order / 재난문자 times per town, 25–early 26 Mar 2025, Gyeongbuk wildfire
method_note: All records come from WebSearch result text (search-engine summaries quoting pages). WebFetch and curl to newsis, imaeil, newsro etc. failed (ENOTFOUND / proxy CONNECT 403), so NO page was read in full (no HTTP 200). Quotes are as surfaced in snippets; Korean quotes marked EN-only where only the English edition surfaced. Treat all as REPORTED. Times are copied as written; no rounding.
